source.name: PR Newswire: Baltimore Orioles and T. Rowe Price Announce Marquee Sponsorship Agreement with Jersey Patch
source.quote: The centerpiece of the deal is a T. Rowe Price-branded uniform patch that will adorn the sleeve of Orioles players' jerseys for all regular season and Postseason games, beginning tomorrow, June 11

note: Jersey patch. Announced as a multiyear partnership; in addition to the jersey patch, the agreement includes ballpark signage, media, hospitality assets, in-game activation, community programs and a brand presence at the Orioles' spring training facility.
